content: litellm pypi package v1.93.0. Two usage modes: (1) SDK-only litellm.completion(model=..., messages=...) in-process, no extra service, supports provider prefixes like groq/llama-3.1-8b-instant; (2) LiteLLM Proxy, a standalone gateway service requiring its own docker container, with OTel v2 tracing (LITELLM_OTEL_V2=true) producing gen_ai.* spans automatically. For a 7-day hackathon with zero docker experience, SDK-only mode avoids running an extra service; Proxy mode adds a docker service but gives automatic GenAI-semconv tracing and fallback/cooldown routing across providers.
